title: Ureueng Meuiman Nyang Teusöm .
intro: Lam aula-aula kekuasaan nyang meugah, teumpat keukafiran ngon tirani meukuasa, saboh su keubeunaran nyang sidroe-droe jipeugah haba nibak teumpat nyang hana teuduga. Angka nyoe ji tantangan otoritas untuk ji lindong sidroe utusan, ji peu resiko keamanan droe jih untuk ji peugah haba nyang beutoi.
clues: Lon tinggai di nanggroe tirani nyang rayeuk, lon layani sidroe penguasa nyang meungaku keutuhanan.
Lon peusöm keuyakinan lon nyang beutoi seulama meuthon-thon, teumakot keu akibat meunyo lon peugah.
Meunyoe sidroe utosan teuka deungon tanda-tanda nyang trang, Ulôn meuiman, teuma umat Ulôn meukomplot jilawan gobnyan.
Lon dong dikeue tiran dan dewan jih, lon peugah bahwa awaknyan hana patot jipoh mate sidroe utusan nyang hana meusalah.
Ulôn peuingat awaknyan keuhai huköman bansa-bansa jameun nyang jitulak keubeunaran, lagée kawôm Nabi Nuh ngon 'Ad.
Allah ka geupeuseulamat ulôn nibak reuncana-reuncana brok awaknjan, dan ulôn ka lôn kalon keuhancô rezim njang zalém njan.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Peudong meunara mangat trok u langèt .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Dipeuseulamat nibak bala seudangkan ureueng-ureueng nyang zalem binasa .
Teungoh ji rhom lam apui dan jiteubiet hana luka .
Meujak-jak lam padang pasi peuet ploh thon treb jih .
outcome.answer: Dipeuseulamat nibak bala seudangkan ureueng-ureueng nyang zalem binasa .

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
